Package neqsim.process.equipment.pipeline

Class TwoFluidMassBalanceReport

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.equipment.pipeline.TwoFluidMassBalanceReport
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public final class TwoFluidMassBalanceReport extends Object implements Serializable
Discrete phase and total-mass balance for one accepted TwoFluidPipe transient call.

Boundary and source terms are integrated with the same Runge-Kutta stage weights as the conservative state. The signed residual is final - initial - (inlet - outlet + source). A positive source adds mass to the reported phase. Oil and water source terms include gas-liquid phase transfer splits; their sum is the liquid source.

    • getRelativeResidual

      public double getRelativeResidual(TwoFluidMassBalanceReport.Phase phase)
      Get absolute residual relative to the largest relevant inventory or integrated transfer.

      The denominator is the maximum of initial inventory, final inventory, and the sum of absolute inlet, outlet, and source contributions. This definition remains finite for phase appearance from zero initial inventory.

      Parameters:
      phase - phase or aggregate
      Returns:
      non-negative relative residual
